entities.summary: Eco Warrior Movement is a non-governmental organization in Ghana working with young people on climate change and environmental sustainability. The movement is a youth-driven and youth-led organization that is intended on restoring degraded landscapes and mitigate climate change through an integrated and inclusive approach. Otuo-Akyampong Boakye, an environmental scientist from Ghana, launched the Eco-Warriors Movement in 2020.
